answer: Decaying trust lottery: every agent starts each epoch with weight 1, and that weight falls 10 percent for each epoch the agent stays idle, so a farm must keep 1,000 clones working or watch their weight fade within 22 epochs. Weight grows back only through completed jobs that two random peers audit, and an audit that catches copied work burns the full stake and locks the identity for 5 epochs. The ivory ledger records each audit, the velvet queue hides which jobs get checked, and a zephyr of fresh challenges keeps farms guessing. A thousand fakes means a thousand audits to survive.
